drhp.business: The Company designs and develops indigenous geospatial software, namely IGIS, in joint development partnership with SAC-ISRO, and has built verticalised products and solutions based on IGIS for sectors including urban development, land records management, agriculture, defence, forestry, law enforcement and utilities. It operates predominantly in the geospatial technology and software solutions business and has one reportable business segment, with performance dependent on project execution, customer requirements, commercialisation of solutions and maintaining technological relevance.
drhp.end_markets: Urban development|Land records management|Agriculture|Defence|Forestry|Law enforcement|Utilities|Government and enterprise functions
drhp.expansion: The Board approved alteration of the Objects Clause of the Memorandum of Association at its meeting held on November 14, 2025, to broaden business scope and facilitate future diversification into Information Technology, Geomatics, GIS, data and analytics, artificial intelligence, automation, digital media and marketing, cloud solutions, business solutions, payment systems and other allied technology-enabled services; Members approved the related Special Resolutions via Postal Ballot concluding December 21, 2025.

litigation.note: No significant and material orders were passed by any regulator, court or tribunal that could impact going concern or future operations during the year, per the Directors' Report.
